title: Identification of Latent Group Effects under Conditional Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2604.08798v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study identification of a structural group effect when the group indicator $G\in\{0,1\}$ is unobserved but the analyst observes a calibrated probability score $p$ satisfying $E[G\mid p,X]=p$. Under a constant-coefficient structural mean model, the latent-group coefficient $\tau$ is point-identified by a closed-form ratio of observable moments whose denominator is the residual score variance $V^{*}=E[(p-E[p\mid X])^2]$. Identification fails exactly when the score is a deterministic function of $X$; we construct an explicit continuum of observationally equivalent models showing the failure is genuine. The marginal latent mean gap decomposes as $\tau$ plus a compositional term that is itself identified in closed form, and we characterise when the two coincide. translated_title: 条件校准下的潜在群体效应识别
translated_abstract: 我们研究当群体指示变量 $G\in\{0,1\}$ 不可观测、但分析者可观测到一个满足 $E[G\mid p,X]=p$ 的经校准概率分数 $p$ 时，结构性群体效应的识别问题。在常系数结构均值模型下，潜在群体系数 $\tau$ 通过一个由可观测矩构成的闭式比率得到点识别，其分母为残差分数方差 $V^{*}=E[(p-E[p\mid X])^2]$。恰好当分数是 $X$ 的确定性函数时，识别失败；我们构造了一个显式的观测等价模型连续统，证明该失败是本质性的。边际潜在均值差距可分解为 $\tau$ 加上一个组成成分项，该项本身具有闭式识别，并且我们刻画了两者何时重合。Oracle 估计量具有 $\sqrt{n}$ 一致性与渐近正态性，并带有闭式三明治方差。在校准误差以 $\delta$ 为界时，偏差服从……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明，当潜在群体指示变量不可观测但存在经条件校准的概率分数时，结构性群体效应系数可由可观测矩的闭式比率实现点识别，精确刻画了识别失败发生的唯一条件，并给出具有 $\sqrt{n}$ 一致性和渐近正态性的估计量及其对校准误差的偏差界。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a structural group-effect coefficient is point-identified in closed form from observable moments using only a conditionally calibrated probability score, precisely characterizes when identification genuinely fails, and establishes root-n-consistent, asymptotically normal estimation with bias bounds under bounded calibration error.
